:::{#sol-prereq-inequality-solve}

The inequality holds for every integer $n > 6$,
that is, for $n \ge 7$.
Subtracting $n$ from both sides and adding 7 gives $2n > 12$,
and dividing both sides by 2 gives $n > 6$.

To review,
read the rule for [multiplying both sides of an inequality by a positive number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#thm-mult-ineq).

:::
